sources.name: TNP: The CBN Agent Banking Guidelines 2025 - Key Innovations and Regulatory Implications

entries.subject: agent_cash_in_daily_limit
entries.display: Agent cash-in (deposit): N100,000 per customer per day
entries.notes: Table row from Article 11 of the CBN Guidelines for the Operations of Agent Banking in Nigeria, 2025: daily N100,000, weekly N500,000.

entries.subject: agent_cash_in_weekly_limit
entries.display: Agent cash-in (deposit): N500,000 per customer per week
entries.notes: Weekly column of the same row.

entries.subject: agent_cash_out_daily_limit
entries.display: Agent cash-out (withdrawal): N100,000 per customer per day

entries.subject: agent_cash_out_weekly_limit
entries.display: Agent cash-out (withdrawal): N500,000 per customer per week

entries.subject: agent_bill_payment_daily_limit
entries.display: Agent bill payment: N100,000 per customer per day and per week
entries.notes: Weekly limit equals the daily limit for bill payments.

entries.subject: agent_daily_cumulative_withdrawal
entries.display: An agent's daily cumulative withdrawal limit may not exceed N1,200,000
entries.quote: They must also ensure each Agent’s daily cumulative withdrawal limit does not exceed ₦1, 200, 000.00.
entries.notes: Float-side cap on the agent, distinct from the per-customer limits.

entries.subject: agent_complaint_resolution
entries.display: Customer complaints must be resolved within 7 days, reduced from 14
entries.quote: all customer complaints must now be resolved within seven (7) days

entries.subject: agent_exclusivity
entries.display: An agent may serve only one principal and belong to only one super-agent network at a time
entries.quote: An Agent can now only engage with one Principal and belong to the network of only one Super Agent at any given time.
entries.notes: Duale, Ovia & Alex-Adedipe (Nov 2025) describes the same 'single-principal structure for agents'. The exclusivity provisions take effect 1 April 2026.

entries.subject: super_agent_conducting_agent_banking
entries.display: Super agents are prohibited from conducting agent banking activities themselves
entries.quote: Super Agents, previously authorised to carry out the dual role of an Agent and Super Agent are now explicitly prohibited from conducting Agent Banking activities.

entries.subject: agent_account_opening_documents
entries.display: An agent may no longer collect or submit account-opening documentation for a financial institution
entries.quote: The PoS operator can no longer collect or submit account-opening documentation or accept loan repayments on behalf of financial institutions.

entries.subject: individual_as_agent
entries.value_text: individuals may be appointed directly as agents
entries.display: Individuals can now be appointed directly as agents, but may not appoint or manage other agents
entries.quote: individuals may now be appointed directly as Agents, provided they meet the prescribed eligibility and due diligence requirements

notes: Limits come from the October 2025 agent banking guidelines as reported by TNP; the CBN's own guideline text is not in the corpus, so confidence is single_source.
